title: Caleb, 27: The $3,100 Refund He Waited For

scenes.say: Caleb's $3,100 tax refund felt like a bonus. It was his own money, just late.
He's 27, and every paycheck withheld more tax than he actually owed.
Spread across the year, that's about $258 a month he never saw.
Meanwhile, a $900 car repair in July had to wait two months.
So Caleb updated his W-4 form at work, so less is withheld each paycheck.
Now that $258 lands every month, and he moves it straight into savings.
Same $3,100 a year, but it's in his account by summer, not next April.
Was your last refund big or small? Subscribe, so it's never $3,100 back and $0 all year again.

Numbers are rounded US estimates for illustration; check your own withholding with your employer or a tax professional.
